remarks: This immaculate, recently updated, bright and sunny second floor apt is nestled on a quiet street near public transportation, schools, shops, restaurants and Byram Shore pool, park and marina - offering everything you need! Enjoy a fabulous open floor plan featuring a spacious living/dining area and a modern kitchen with quartz island, stainless steel appliances and stacked W/D in unit. The primary suite is complemented by 2 additional bedrooms and a full bath. Ample closet space, central A/C and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. Includes a one car garage with additional driveway parking. The expansive backyard provides plenty of space for entertaining or outdoor fun! Available May 1st.
